description: Java class representing immutable flat data for joint liability group's collection sheet in the Fineract project, encapsulating various financial and demographic details related to a collection sheet entry.

classes.name: JLGCollectionSheetFlatData
classes.description: Immutable data object for extracting flat data for joint liability group's collection sheet.

methods.name: JLGCollectionSheetFlatData
methods.description: Constructor initializing all data fields for the flat data object.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Returns the name of the group.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the group.

methods.name: getStaffName
methods.description: Returns the name of the staff member.

methods.name: getProductShortName
methods.description: Returns the short name of the product.

methods.name: getLoanDueData
methods.description: Returns a LoanDueData object encapsulating loan-related financial info.

methods.name: getClientData
methods.description: Returns client data object with attendance information.

methods.name: getJLGGroupData
methods.description: Returns group data object with group and staff details.
